title: Sea air sours it
html_source:
India Pale Ale (IPA) was created because beer shipped to India turned sour en route.

Just imagine yourself in the middle of India with all this great food around and no good bottle of suds to wash it down with. All the beer shipped from England arrived sour and flat.
http://www.hamptons.com/Out-And-About/From-Where-Im-Standing/1623/India-Pale-Ale-Explained.html#.VuXsZ5KV3kd
Originally Posted: May 31, 2007
Lon S. Cohen
